statement: The T1 targetedTests gate check runs `sh run-tests.sh`, which executes `grep -q correct src/impl.txt`. The current content of src/impl.txt is the literal string 'wrong' (no occurrence of 'correct'), so grep exits 1, causing the targetedTests check to fail deterministically as reported (exit 1). This is unrelated to the actual auth registration/login/logout/session behavior described in the task — it is a Phase 0 offline harness fixture gating on a trivial string match, and no real auth implementation source has been provided in the bundle yet.
